## Project Information
- **Name:** GatherPlay
- **Type:** Full-stack multiplayer social deduction games platform
- **Tech Stack:** 
  - Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
  - Backend: Node.js + Express + Socket.IO
  - Real-time: Socket.IO for multiplayer
  - Styling: TailwindCSS
- **Games:** Insider, Werewords, Feed the Kraken, Deception: Murder in Hong Kong
- **Target:** Support thousands of concurrent players
